packageRules.description: React types follow the React runtime, which the Expo SDK pins, so their majors only move with an SDK upgrade.
Babel majors only move with an SDK upgrade, since babel-preset-expo has to support them first.
React Navigation majors only move with an SDK upgrade, since expo-router is built on a specific major.
A graphql major waits on the Dependency Dashboard for approval. Approve it once every @graphql-codegen/* package accepts it as a peer, or codegen fails.
